sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: High-Speed Dipping Production of Powder-Free Synthetic Nitrile Gloves

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (US-derived corporate and commercial law, Marshallese customary law, and English common-law principles)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association between the Government of the United States of America and the Government of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, Title II Economic Relations, signed 1986, amended 2003
Pacific Island Countries Trade Agreement (PICTA), Pacific Islands Forum Treaty, in force for the Republic of the Marshall Islands

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act, Title 10, Marshall Islands Revised Code (as amended); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Act 2018 (RMI Public Law No. 2018-69) and subsequent AML/CFT Regulations; Marshall Islands Companies (Ultimate Beneficial Ownership) Register Rules, issued by the Registrar of Corporations and the Financial Intelligence Unit

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft Articles of Incorporation (Name Clearance Submission)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Marshall Islands Registered Agent on behalf of beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization before a Marshall Islands notary; Apostille not required for domestic Registry filing; Consular Legalization required if the document is executed abroad and relies on foreign notarization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing the Resident Registered Agent and Corporate Service Provider
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Each proposed shareholder and director in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if issuing state is a party) followed by RMI Consular Legalization; otherwise full consular legalization through the RMI Ministry of Foreign Affairs

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Ultimate Beneficial Ownership Declaration and Source of Wealth Statement
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Each individual that directly or indirectly owns 25% or more of the proposed Business Corporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization, Hague Apostille from the competent authority of the country of origin, and RMI Consular Legalization for foreign-language instruments accompanied by a certified English translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copies of valid national passports and proof of residential address of all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing governmental authority and bank or utility issuer in UBO's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization; each foreign-language page must be translated by a certified translator and notarized

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank and professional reference letters for each UBO and corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Regulated bank, licensed attorney, or certified public accountant in the UBO's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or RMI Consular Legalization, together with notarized signature confirmation and certified English translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory adverse-media and sanctions screening of every UBO, director, signatory, and any authorized agent against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the United States OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, the United Kingdom HMT Consolidated Sanctions List, the European Union CFSP sanctions list, and the Marshall Islands domestic list published by the Financial Intelligence Unit. Politically Exposed Persons are subject to enhanced due diligence verifying source of wealth and source of funds; evidence of screening must be retained in the corporate record for at least five years after termination of the business relationship. Any positive match triggers immediate reporting to the Marshall Islands Financial Intelligence Unit under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Act 2018.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Companies Registry Online Portal maintained by the Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General; name search and pre-clearance applications are lodged by a licensed resident registered agent
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official corporate record is maintained in English in Latin script. A proposed name may include Marshallese-language words, but each non-Latin character name must be transliterated into the English alphabet at application. Names must be visually distinguishible on the record and must not be identical or deceptively similar to any existing reserved, registered, or licensed entity name. Standard corporate identifiers and punctuation are permitted only in the exact statutory suffix such as 'Business Corporation', 'Corp.', 'Inc.', 'Ltd.' or 'BC'.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: On rejection, the registered agent receives a written refusal notice citing the statutory ground. Within fourteen calendar days of refusal, the applicant may file an administrative appeal through the same registered agent, using the Registrar of Corporations' prescribed appeal form, setting out the grounds of distinctiveness, the official search evidence, and the intended usage certificate. The Registrar must issue a written decision within ten business days of the appeal hearing. If the appeal is unsuccessful, the applicant may seek judicial review in the High Court of the Marshall Islands within twenty-one calendar days after the written denial.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual-only offices are not permissible as the statutory registered office of a Marshall Islands Business Corporation. The company must continuously maintain a physical registered office in the Republic of the Marshall Islands, addressed to the office of a licensed registered agent, whereprocess of summons may be served, during all business hours. For the business scope of sterile medical-device glove manufacturing, a virtual office cannot satisfy the production-license premises requirement; the legal entity must maintain a physical manufacturing facility if it plans to exercise the manufacturing licence, or must clearly outsource manufacturing and hold only the distribution and trade contracts.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: The initial statutory-license inspection for medical PPE manufacturing is mandatory at 100% before the issuance of a manufacturing approval, and an unannounced physical inspection probability of 35% per annum applies thereafter for licensed manufacturing entities engaged in high-speed synthetic glove dipping. For a company holding only an import and distribution authorization without in-country manufacturing, the unannounced inspection probability is estimated at 10% per annum.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate name reservation and pre-clearance search fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Marshall Islands Companies Registry, Office of the Attorney General; processing via licensed resident registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee prescribed under Business Corporations Act Regulations and Registry Fee Schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government filing fee for the Articles of Incorporation under the Business Corporations Act
First year statutory resident registered agent and registered office service fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Marshall Islands registered agent and corporate service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market tariff for non-resident Business Corporation maintenance

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO profiling, AML identification, PEP and sanctions screening, and beneficial-ownership registry filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Marshall Islands Financial Intelligence Unit via the licensed corporate service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Compliance tariff under AML/CFT Act 2018 and UBO Register Rules; incorporates screening tool licences

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, Hague Apostille, and RMI Consular Legalization of UBO and shareholder identity documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public in each document's origin jurisdiction, apostille-issuing foreign ministry, and RMI Consular/foreign-affairs authentication unit
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory service fees of the foreign ministry plus RMI consular fee schedule; market rate for courier and translation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Medical PPE manufacturing licence application fee (ISIC 3250; NAICS 339113)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Marshall Islands Ministry of Health and Human Services, Public Health Regulatory Unit
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Public Health Act licence-assessment and medical-device manufacturing inspection tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation corporate, tax, AML/CFT, and regulatory legal advisory fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External Marshall Islands-licensed attorney and international tax advisor
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for non-resident offshore Business Corporation formation with regulatory de-risking and UBO documentation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act 1990, as amended (Title 27, Marshall Islands Revised Code); applicable Sections 15 (Certificate of Incorporation), 21 (Registered Office and Registered Agent), 27 (Bylaws), 35 (Directors), and 42 (Officers)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Business Corporations, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands, Majuro
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; a non-resident business corporation may adopt nominal authorized capital, such as US$1.00. No escrow or paid-in capital account is required at the time of incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: That the subscription of the incorporator(s) to issued shares be approved and that certificates be issued to the subscribers upon payment of the agreed par or no-par value consideration. RESOLVED FURTHER: That the registered office of the Corporation be established at the address of the qualified registered agent, and that such agent be authorized to accept service of process and official notices. RESOLVED FURTHER: That the officers listed as President, Secretary and Treasurer, or such other officers appointed, assume office and exercise the powers granted by the Bylaws. RESOLVED FURTHER: That the Bylaws as adopted govern the Corporation until duly amended.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Clearance and Corporate Governance Scope Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Business Corporations, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request through a licensed registered agent, confirming the corporate name is distinct from existing registered entities and lawful suffixes are used. Attach the written consent of the proposed registered agent and state the intended purposes, including ISIC 3250 medical nitrile glove manufacturing.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or queried, file a response and substitute an alternative distinguishing name within five business days; re-submit through the registered agent portal with corrected designation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engagement of Registered Agent and Registered Office Location
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agents under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute a registered agent agreement with an approved licensed agent and establish the registered office at the agent’s public office in Majuro or Ebeye. The registered agent will maintain the statutory register and accept service of process for the Corporation.
required_dossiers: Identity verification documents of directors and shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent is disqualified or refuses appointment, promptly engage another licensed agent and file a change of registered agent notice to correct the statutory record.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation in English, stating corporate name, registered agent, business purpose broad enough to cover glove manufacturing and sales, authorized share structure, initial directors, and any limitations on powers. Execute the Articles before a notary public or other official recognized by the Registrar.
required_dossiers: Apostilled or notarized Articles of Incorporation
Consent to act as director for each initial director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar returns the Articles for correction, cure the noted deficiencies and re-file the conformed instrument within ten business days, paying any supplementary certification fee if required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing, Fee Payment, and Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Business Corporations, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the final Articles of Incorporation, together with the required filing fee and any franchise tax deposit, through the Registrar’s online portal or counter service. After examination and approval, the Registrar will stamp the Articles and issue the Certificate of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Registered agent consent and annual address verification
Certificate of good name reservation, if issued
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is placed under query, provide the requested supplementary information within ten business days; if rejection is issued, appeal by way of a written application to the Registrar or commence a fresh filing with corrected Articles.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bylaw Adoption and Initial Share Subscription
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporators and Initial Board of Directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Adopt the Bylaws providing for share ownership, quorum, director powers, officer positions, indemnification, and financial year. Approve the initial share subscription in writing or by unanimous consent in lieu of a formal meeting, and record the consideration and issuance of shares.
required_dossiers: Written consent of sole incorporator or minutes of organization meeting
Share subscription schedule and payment evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the share subscription or officer appointments are discovered to be incomplete, ratify the actions by subsequent written unanimous consent with retroactive effect to the date of incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Officer Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct the first board meeting or execute unanimous written consents to approve issuance of shares, adopt the corporate seal, designate principal banks for LC and TT operations, appoint the President, Secretary and Treasurer, and authorize opening of corporate bank accounts. Prepare and file the minutes and resolutions in the corporate minute book.
required_dossiers: First board meeting minutes or written consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any officer appointment is invalid or a director fails to qualify, the board may pass a corrective resolution, remove the affected officer, and file the amended officer register with the statutory records.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Resources and Development – Manufacturing Licensing Division, coordinated with the Ministry of Health and Human Services – Public Health Division
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Medical Device / PPE Manufacturing Establishment License for Sterile Examination Nitrile Gloves

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Marshall Islands Environmental Protection Authority (RMI EPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category I – Full Environmental Impact Assessment Report required for industrial chemical dipping, nitrile compounding, and wastewater discharge operations
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge must meet RMI EPA effluent standards: pH 6.0–9.0, biochemical oxygen demand (BOD5) ≤ 30 mg/L, total suspended solids ≤ 50 mg/L, oil and grease ≤ 10 mg/L, and ammonia/nitrogen within permitted limits. VOC emissions from dipping and curing lines require scrubbing or thermal oxidation achieving at least 95% capture or removal efficiency. Hazardous solid waste, spent process chemicals, and leachate must be managed under a licensed hazardous waste manifest and may not be discharged to lagoon or groundwater.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification and inspection by the Majuro Fire and Rescue Service; structural load certification by a licensed civil engineer; occupational workplace clearance under Marshall Islands labor and safety rules, including emergency evacuation planning, fire extinguishing system installation, first-aid provisions, and chemical exposure monitoring for any dipping-line personnel.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands Ministry of Finance – Revenue and Taxation Division, Majuro; no separately branded national online tax portal is generally available to foreign entities.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign non-resident Business Corporation is not required to obtain a VAT ID because the RMI has no VAT system. If it carries on any business within the Republic, it must file a gross revenue tax registration application with the Revenue and Taxation Division, attaching the certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, particulars of the registered agent, and the RMI business license; a Tax Identification Number is then issued. A non-resident exempt Business Corporation operates solely outside the RMI and typically does not obtain a local TIN, but must maintain its registration number with the Registrar of Corporations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: RMI law does not provide check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections. A non-resident Business Corporation maintains its exempt status by ensuring it does not carry on business within the Republic; there is no election to be treated as a pass-through entity.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT/GST/Sales and Use Tax (RMI levies customs import duties and a 3% gross revenue tax on business carried on within the Republic)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: USD – no VAT/GST registration threshold exists; a person carrying on a business in the Republic must register for gross revenue tax from the first dollar of local source gross revenue.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No e-invoicing, continuous transaction controls, fiscal clearance, API clearance, or digital stamping mandate is in force. Import and export declarations are processed through the RMI Customs and Trade Administration, using customs declaration forms and available national electronic customs platforms.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: No VAT zero-rating mechanism exists in the RMI. Exports of sterile examination nitrile gloves are outside the scope of any consumption tax; therefore no zero-rating claim may be made. For gross revenue tax purposes, export revenue derived by a non-resident Business Corporation from customers outside the Republic is non-RMI source income and is not subject to gross revenue tax, provided the entity does not carry on business within the RMI.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: RMI Customs Export Declaration or equivalent export entry document
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing dispatch from the port of export
Inward remittance certificate or commercial bank SWIFT documentation evidencing receipt of foreign currency export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The RMI has no export VAT zero-rating refunds to claw back. False declarations or fraudulent misrepresentations in customs and gross revenue matters may result in forfeiture of goods, reassessment of duties and taxes, civil penalties up to 50% of the underpaid amount, statutory interest, and criminal fines. A non-resident entity that misrepresents its exempt status can lose tax-exempt treatment and become liable for gross revenue tax retrospectively.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Not applicable. The Republic of the Marshall Islands maintains no central bank and no foreign-exchange administration. The U.S. dollar is sole legal tender, so monetary authority is effectively exercised by the U.S. Federal Reserve; prudential licensing and supervision of banks are vested in the Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, pursuant to the Banking Act 1990 (as amended).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Total currency convertibility, both de jure and de facto. Since no domestic currency exists, all payments are denominated in U.S. dollars and neither current-account nor capital-account transactions are subject to RMI exchange-control approval, conversion quotas, profit-remittance taxes, or repatriation licensing. Dividends, management fees, and capital reductions may be remitted freely once board approval and solvency conditions under the Business Corporation Act are satisfied. The only practical hurdles to profit remittance are commercial: correspondent-bank de-risking in the Pacific corridor, FATF-oriented documentation, and the receiving bank's own compliance policies.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None applicable. RMI law imposes no statutory deadline, no mandatory conversion percentage, and no surrender or repatriation duty for export receipts. Export proceeds may be held in USD onshore or offshore indefinitely without filing any foreign-exchange declaration with the Marshall Islands Government.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Operational Account / Capital Escrow Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium. The RMI has no dedicated e-money-institution or payment-services licensing regime; an offshore digital EMI holding or disbursing treasury funds is not a recognized 'bank' under the Banking Act 1990 and may create shell-institution/unauthorized-deposit-taking concerns for RMI-facing compliance. The route is workable only as an ancillary, non-primary disbursement channel, and only where the EMI independently holds a valid license in its home jurisdiction (e.g., UK FCA, Singapore MAS, HKMA) and the full UBO/trade-documentation bundle is available.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statutory requirement exists for directors to appear physically in the Marshall Islands. Remote onboarding is uniformly accepted for non-resident business corporations, provided every director and ultimate beneficial owner completes a live video-identification interview, supplies certified passport/address proofs, and the registered agent countersigns the account-opening authorization. Foreign banks in Hong Kong, Singapore, or the United States will extend the same remote standard when the corporate dossier is certified as described below.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident offshore corporation with no physical RMI footprint and opaquely presented beneficial ownership.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified certificate of incorporation; memorandum and articles of association; current certificate of good standing from the RMI Registrar of Corporations; register of directors and register of shareholders; certificate of incumbency executed by the registered agent; UBO declaration and source-of-wealth affidavit; board resolution authorizing account opening; corporate group organigram evidencing the manufacturing affiliate and physical goods flow.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Negative-listing and correspondent-bank de-risking screens triggered by RMI tax-haven/regulatory reputation concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Regulatory-status memorandum from the RMI corporate agent summarizing current FATF/APG and EU Code of Conduct Group outcomes; economic-substance evidence (supply contracts, factory lease, payroll records of the operating subsidiary); OFAC, EU, and UN sanctions list screening results for all counterparties; and audited financial statements demonstrating real revenue from glove production and sales.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Medical PPE sector procurement sensitivity (price inflation, COVID-era fraud association, mis-invoicing).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: ISO 13485 certificate, CE-marking documentation, and FDA 510(k) clearance or establishment registration for the sterile nitrile gloves; manufacturer capacity and inventory verification report; purchase orders and pro-forma invoices at market reference pricing; independent third-party inspection certificates (SGS/TUV/Intertek) per shipment; full shipping file (bill of lading, packing list, certificate of origin, customs declarations) reconciling quantity, price, and payment.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume TT/LC payments to third-country glove factories with thin economic substance of the paying entity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed master production, purchase, and distribution agreements; capital-call memorandum and linked shareholder remittance records; payment-reconciliation ledger mapping each wire or document presentation to a specific commercial invoice and shipment; annual audited financial statements; written treasury policy governing outbound disbursement and segregation of client and own funds.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route all shareholder subscriptions and intercompany capital via SWIFT MT103 in USD with narrative field 70 citing CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION PER BOARD RESOLUTION [NO. AND DATE] or INTERCOMPANY LOAN DISBURSEMENT, as applicable. The remitter must pre-clear the purpose code and beneficiary tax/registration identifiers with the receiving bank; the RMI BC should deliver a board resolution, subscribed share certificates or facility agreement, and a capital-call memorandum so that the credit is posted without AML auto-rejection. For loan-class injections, execute a written facility agreement at arm's length and preserve the full funding trail, as classification of the transfer may affect the lender's home-country CFC/GLTI reporting even though it is tax-neutral within the RMI.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use two primary rails: (1) irrevocable documentary letters of credit issued under UCP 600 via SWIFT MT700 for equipment and initial bulk consignments, with settlement effected by SWIFT MT103/MT202 and reimbursement by MT202 COV to ensure full-cover transparency; and (2) direct TT/wire disbursements via SWIFT MT103 for regularly repeating raw-material or finished-goods shipments, each referencing the commercial invoice and purchase-order numbers in the payment narrative. All outbound instructions must match invoice, packing-list, bill-of-lading, and certificate-of-origin data to survive pre-screening at both the originating and clearing banks.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/MYR onshore deliverable forward contract with a licensed Malaysian bank, supported by the underlying glove-export receivables or payables
USD/CNY non-deliverable forward (NDF), settled in USD with an offshore licensed dealer, to hedge remittance costs denominated in yuan
USD/CNH or USD/VND cross-currency swap under an ISDA/CSA master agreement for balance-sheet net-investment or working-capital hedging
USD/VND non-deliverable forward where the production plant is located in Vietnam and costs are incurred in dong

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report (Corporate Annual Return and franchise fee declaration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation date; due on or before the anniversary date, with a 30-day late-filing grace period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of USD 100 per month or part of a month after the 30-day grace period; if the annual report and fee remain unpaid for six consecutive months, the Registrar may strike the company off after notice, causing automatic dissolution and loss of legal standing until reinstated.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory statutory audit for a non-resident exempt Business Corporation. An independent audit is required only where the corporation is listed on a recognized exchange, is a licensed financial or insurance institution, or where a shareholder resolution or creditor covenant requires audited financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory requirement to file financial statements with the Registrar. Books and records must be maintained accurately to explain transactions; IFRS is the accepted framework for group reporting, and Marshall Islands exempt companies commonly maintain accounts under IFRS or home-country GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Marshall Islands BCA does not require a standalone annual UBO return to the Registrar. The registered agent must maintain a beneficial ownership register; once each calendar year, concurrent with the annual report cycle, the directors must confirm in writing the current registered member list and any transfers or changes in beneficial ownership, with an update within 30 days after a share transfer.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Beneficial Ownership held by Registered Agent

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: No statutory fee; voluntary certified audit typically USD 8,000 - USD 20,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% corporate income tax rate for non-resident Marshall Islands Business Corporations not engaged in trade or business in the Republic of the Marshall Islands. A 3% Gross Revenue Tax applies only if the corporation derives RMI-source gross revenue through an actual RMI business nexus.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective tax rate for a non-resident BC with no RMI domestic business nexus; no income tax holiday statute, but the statutory exemption is permanent; registration fees, annual franchise/report fees, and registered agent fees remain payable.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No RMI corporate income tax return exists for non-resident Business Corporations. Equivalent statutory compliance filing: Annual Report under the RMI Business Corporations Act, filed with the Registrar of Corporations through a licensed RMI registered agent via the RMI corporate registry/electronic filing system.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual Report is due on or before the anniversary of the date of incorporation in each calendar year. The deadline is not aligned to a fiscal year-end for income tax purposes because no corporate income tax is imposed on a non-resident BC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent name and RMI registered office street address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident BC must maintain a licensed RMI registered agent and a physical Majuro registered address; a P.O. Box is insufficient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact corporation name and Registrar-issued registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the exact name reserved under the BCA and the serial number issued at incorporation; do not use trade names.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital, par value, and share classes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum capital is required; non-resident BCs may authorize no-par-value shares. The annual fee is computed on authorized capital.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names and addresses of directors and corporate secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors and officers may be non-resident and may be legal entities; provide full registered addresses even if located outside RMI.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal office address and contact details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The principal office may be a foreign address; an RMI address is not required. A foreign principal office supports non-resident exemption status.
Non-resident BC should declare that it is not carrying on trade or business in RMI and identify its jurisdiction of tax residence to avoid an ESR filing obligation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers Registrar late fees and accruing monthly surcharges on the annual fee; continued non-filing may result in administrative dissolution, loss of Certificate of Good Standing, closure of bank/LC/TT payment rails, and reinstatement costs.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — the Republic of the Marshall Islands imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by a Business Corporation to non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable in practice: RMI has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network. Only tax information exchange and limited treaty instruments exist. If a future DTA applied, the shareholder would be required to obtain and submit a tax residence certificate from its jurisdiction, provide a beneficial ownership declaration through the registered agent, and invoke treaty relief before payment; because the statutory WHT rate is 0%, no administrative relief mechanism is currently required.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 0% statutory WHT on patent, know-how, trademark, and process royalties paid to non-residents. Interest: 0% statutory WHT on debt interest paid to non-resident creditors. No treaty reduced rate is available because no DTA exists.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: USD 0 — no statutory transfer pricing documentation threshold or Local File/Master File regime is codified in RMI law. A non-resident BC engaged in a multinational nitrile-glove supply chain should nevertheless maintain transactional documents and an economic rationale to avoid adverse recharacterization by the shareholder's home tax authority.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: RMI Economic Substance Regulations apply to RMI-tax-resident entities carrying on relevant activities, including or covering distribution and services, financing/leasing, headquarters, holding companies, and IP holding. For this non-resident Medical PPE business, RMI substance is not required if the entity is tax-resident outside RMI and files the necessary foreign tax-residency declaration; however, if the entity is treated as RMI-resident or performs any relevant activity in RMI, it must maintain physical employees, premises, and adequate RMI operating expenditure in proportion to income.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Representing the MH_BC as a tax-exempt non-resident corporation while actually managing, negotiating, storing, invoicing, or procuring high-speed sterile nitrile glove production from an RMI presence, or deriving RMI-source gross revenue through an RMI distribution or procurement office.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Immediate reassessment of the 3% Gross Revenue Tax on all unreported RMI-source receipts; late payment penalties and interest; substantial civil fraud penalties; criminal fines and imprisonment for wilful false filing and concealment; revocation of registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false declarations or knowingly divert RMI-source receipts outside the BC can be assessed personally for restitution, penalties, and interest; courts will pierce the corporate veil; travel bans and surrender of passports may be imposed in criminal tax proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using a mailbox-only RMI BC with no employees, premises, or business operations to pass through nitrile-glove purchase invoices while falsely claiming foreign tax residence and failing to file the required annual economic substance declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Registrar administrative dissolution, financial penalties under the Economic Substances Regulations, revocation of the Certificate of Good Standing, adverse exchange-of-information referral to the home tax authority, and possible treatment of the BC as tax-resident in the customer's jurisdiction with assessment under controlled-foreign-company rules.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for unlawful distributions and false declarations; the corporate veil may be pierced when the shell entity is merely an instrument of fraud, exposing directors to civil restitution, personal bankruptcy, entry bans, and imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using Swift_LC or TT_Wire payment rails to settle glove shipments through shell intermediaries, obscuring ultimate beneficial owners, over- or under-invoicing against arm's length values, or transacting with sanctioned persons, prohibited end users, or high-risk jurisdictions with false shipping documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Referral to the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit; criminal anti-money laundering penalties including imprisonment and corporate fines; confiscation and freezing orders over PPE inventory, bank accounts, and letters-of-credit proceeds; revocation of business registration; exclusion from correspondent banking.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers who authorize or fail to identify suspicious transactions face personal criminal liability, fines, imprisonment, travel bans, asset seizure, and disqualification from serving as directors of any RMI entity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Fraudulent Trade / Veil Piercing by Creditors
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Committing fraud against trade creditors, LC banks, or buyers by commingling personal and corporate funds, operating the BC with severe undercapitalization, transferring inventory and receivables out of the BC before settling supplier debts, or issuing false financial statements to obtain TT wiring and documentary credit facilities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil restitution of misappropriated assets, compensatory and punitive damages, court-ordered freezing of bank accounts and LC proceeds, administrative liquidation, and criminal prosecution for fraudulent trading.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil will be pierced; directors and controlling shareholders are jointly and severally liable for the BC's debts, with personal exposure to asset attachment, travel bans, seizure of passports, disqualification orders, and imprisonment for intentional fraud.
